reviews.title: New update is terrible
reviews.text: Super frustrated by the paywalls of the new update. Features that were previously free are now part of the paid subscription. I’ve been ttc for over a year and been enjoying this app for keeping track of my records. The history of charts is no longer available. Reached out on their app as they suggested and they just suggested paying for the subscription. Will be looking to switch to a new app.

reviews.title: Love
reviews.text: Five star

reviews.title: Boo!
reviews.text: Why did you lock down previous cycles in the new update? This “feature” used to be included in the base version of the app and is the WHOLE point of the app: tracking cycles. Way to piss off women who are trying to conceive and make their lives more difficult. This app no longer has a use to me. You need to revert this change.

reviews.title: Use to love Premom
reviews.text:
Used to love this app. Great for LH tracking and fertility feedback. 

However, for the pregnancy section a paywall was added for weekly pregnancy updates September 2026, that used to be free. I had to switch apps mid pregnancy and find another app that would offer the updates for free. I suggest at least adding an option to watch ads to access this info. I can’t afford to pay monthly for info that’s available elsewhere.

reviews.title: Predatory practice
reviews.text: This app will not let you access the previous months cycle data unless you unlock/upgrade for a fee. It was 5/5 till they recently made this change, I will be deleting. Was good while it lasted.

reviews.title: Paywalled info and date without notice
reviews.text: The latest update now blocks me from the weekly information my husband and I looked forward to learning about our baby. This used to be with the free account and no information was shared to users prior to the update. It’s disappointing that they’ve now blocked all of the nice free features and are requiring people to pay.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: I used premom when I was trying to conceive all the way up to my 8th month of pregnancy, and then all of a sudden they paywalled everything including your previous data you uploaded. They want to make you pay to even see the monthly baby updates for each week which used to just be free. Seems predatory and like they try to bully you into paying for features which were free before this especially with no warning. Deleted and will be using a different app moving forward.

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text: The app is practically unusable now that everything is locked behind a paywall. The interface is outdated and not intuitive, which was fine when the app was still usable with the free version. It does not make sense to pay for this app, there are much nicer ones out there that are free to use.

reviews.title: Was extremely happy but now it’s not worth it
reviews.text: I have been using this to track my cycles and was finally starting to see trends that were enlightening. Now it’s all blocked and I wasn’t able to save anything. This is extremely frustrating as this last year was spent trying to build a picture of my fertility.

reviews.title: Much better apps out there
reviews.text:
Everything is a paywall. There is really no value here. There are apps that give you much better expectations of week to week pregnancy updates. 

The articles are super generic categories you can google. 

Don’t waste your time or money. What to expect is a much better app with better content.

reviews.title: Money Grab update
reviews.text:
The new update is a complete money grab at moms who want simple info and facts.. I’ve used this app through my whole pregnancy as fun little check ins to
see how big my baby is and fun little things i can share with others about her growth. I shouldn’t have to pay for something i’ve had access to this entire time.

reviews.title: Paywall to see my information
reviews.text: This app was so good and now they’re just greedy for asking us to pay to see our information. What’s wrong with this app.

reviews.title: Switch and bait
reviews.text: Before their latest update, they asked me to take an optional survey to see how I prefer to navigate a new layout. When I downloaded the new update, I did see layout changes but they also decided to, without warning, put all our histories (past cycles) behind a paywall. That is disgusting and betraying behavior as I am preparing for my first rep endo visit. I will no longer be using this app, stop buying their strips, and never recommending again.

reviews.title: Paywall
reviews.text:
I have been TTC and consistently tracking my data in this app for a year. I have a doctor’s appointment next week and was ready to bring a full year of data with me, only to suddenly find that all of my previously recorded data is now locked behind a paywall with no warning.

It’s incredibly frustrating and disappointing to trust an app with a year’s worth of important information, only to lose access to data you already entered unless you pay for a subscription.

reviews.title: It used to be great
reviews.text: Switched from Flo to Premom within the past 2 years after Flo got paywall greedy. Premom WAS great. The free version let me see my previous months charts, which has helped a lot with tracking my cycle. Now all of a sudden its all behind a paywall. Literally everything but the current cycles logs. How does this help? Disappointed. Will now be moving on to another app to hopefully actually care and help with TTC.

reviews.title: Paywall Greed
reviews.text:
I have really enjoyed the weekly tips as I have progressed through my pregnancy. Honestly, it was the only reason I kept the app as everything else is locked behind a paywall. Now with the latest update, even just reading the weekly tips is paywalled. So unless you want to shell out the money for features that are free on other apps, there is no reason to use Premom anymore.
Extremely disappointed.

reviews.title: Removed all data without notice
reviews.text: Good app until without warning blocked all previous data without warning. The only way to accede MY data is to pay now. Seems very predatory.

reviews.title: Money Suckers
reviews.text: Learned a lot about my cycle from this app HOWEVER now they want me to subscribe to get access to simple things that haven’t required a subscription the last year of me using this app. I will NOT BE SUBSCRIBING!!!! Ridiculous

reviews.title: I LOVED this app when it was free…
reviews.text:
There have always been a few features that required premium which was fine with me. But reading the daily and weekly blurb updates was my favorite part of this app once I got pregnant. I suggested it to many friends and was a big fan of the ovulation tracker and “try to conceive” program. Unfortunately these are now pay features only. :( 
Im 37 weeks pregnant now and won’t get to read the last couple of weekly articles due to this update.

reviews.title: Too much behind a paywall
reviews.text: I loved the Premom app when I was using it to track ovulation with LH testing. It helped me understand my cycle better. I was using it to track my pregnancy but now they’ve made it so things that used to be free (ie pregnancy week overview) are only part of a subscription. It was a fun way to know what was happening with my body and growing baby. But I can no longer access it because they can’t more money.

reviews.title: Use to be better before the update!
reviews.text: Can no longer see weekly updates, have to upgrade/pay to see this info now. Other apps have it for free so I decided to delete the app, especially now that I’m 39 weeks and don’t really need it anymore. It was just fun to see the “size” of my baby and the facts each week.

reviews.title: Changed included feature to be a paid subscription 👎
reviews.text: I am 35 weeks into pregnancy and all of the sudden the “free” week by week guide that came with the app when I purchased ovulation strips is no longer available and they’re wanting me to pay a membership. I’ll just google weekly guides from other websites instead of wasting money to get a simple feature that was once included with my purchase.

reviews.title: Not good with the free version
reviews.text: Unfortunately with the last update there really aren’t many features without the subscription. I will no longer use the app and will instead use the one my insurance covers. It’s too bad because I like this app better but I’m not willing to pay for the sub. I can’t even use the growth tracking anymore.

reviews.title: Main features behind paywall
reviews.text: I’ve been using PreMom throughout my pregnancy and have loved the weekly updates about how the baby is growing. Week 34 into my pregnancy and as of this week the basic weekly updates are now a subscription feature. Very disappointed, I’ll be looking elsewhere.

reviews.title: Update removed features unless you pay
reviews.text: The app was already extremely annoying with constant pop ups asking me to upgrade or buy one of their stupid products. But this past month they updated their app that removes the ability for us to see past cycle history without upgrading to premium. Why on earth would I use an app to log my periods if I can’t see any data from the cycle before. There’s no point in logging your cycle if the app isn’t going to allow me to see it on the cycle after! That’s literally the whole  point. Why would they take the most basic function of this app GREEDY. I hope you lose the money though thought you’d gain from doing this. Deleting the app.

reviews.title: Greediness in Pregnancy Apps
reviews.text: Great for tracking LH strips but now that I’m a few weeks away from meeting my firstborn, there’s been an unexpected “update” to the app where I have to pay to see any further progress/symptoms. With what I have to pay for LH strips, pregnancy tests, baby equipment, baby clothes, baby appointments- it’s ridiculous! I deleted the app because I’m done with the greediness. Looking at other app options in the future.

reviews.title: Greedy!
reviews.text:
When I just started using this app I could easily track my period and ovulation. when I got pregnant i found out that the app can also be used as pregnancy tracker with a lot of information and interesting texts on pregnancy. As long as the time passed they blocked everything and now you need to pay for premium membership in order to use it.
At this point it’s useless unless you willing to pay, while there are other free apps

reviews.title: Need money
reviews.text: A feature that was free last week they want you to get premium for now. Baby center and what to expect are free and so is TikTok. Nobody is paying you 9.99 a month to read paragraphs readily available on the internet.

reviews.title: Recent paywall change
reviews.text: They recently updated the app so that you cant access your own information. This is incredibly unethical since this is data users entered themselves. They no longer allow access to pregnancy guides unless you pay. So the free version of the app is pretty much useless.

reviews.title: Worst interface of all the apps
reviews.text: You will get meaningless graphs that are NOT based on your data. You could enter nothing and they will still show you an ovulation date. You will get bombarded with ads to upgrade, to buy their pregnancy tests, to pay to see your previous cycles, and of course all this will pop up WHILE you’re searching through your data. You cannot correct info once entered. The community message board is just an AI bot entering “have you heard of …” content that is not useful or beyond common knowledge. I use this app for the pics of the LH sticks and nothing else. If this app didn’t have that one function, no one would use it.

reviews.title: No longer worth it
reviews.text: Used the app for LH tracking and had successful conception. Moved on to using the next step of weekly info regarding pregnancy, and app has since required this to be under paid subscription. Also reading online that those still using it TTC can no longer access data. Not an app I will use for the remainder of my pregnancy or go back to if TTC again in the future.

reviews.title: Charging for everything now!
reviews.text: Wow. Very disappointed to learn that we now have to pay to go back to the daily updates as well as to see the weekly ones? What’s the point of this app anymore if you have to pay for everything?! Ridiculous.

reviews.title: Changed App-Have to pay
reviews.text: I loved using this app for ovulation tracking and then for pregnancy until I went to read my 33 week update and everything was behind a pay wall. There was no warning or anything and now I would have to pay to have access to all the information I have put in the app for the past 8 months. Extremely frustrating. This app is not worth paying for and the way they took away such important and special information from the past 8 months of my pregnancy without warning is unacceptable.

reviews.title: Removed almost all features on free version and paid version is expensive!
reviews.text: They’ve recently stripped all features from the free version— and now require a premium subscription for something I can spend 20 minutes creating in excel with AI (cycle graphs). For the price of $12.99 per month that is pretty ridiculous. Definitely no longer worth downloading in my opinion, I’m going to make my own cycle graphs.

reviews.title: Paywall update
reviews.text: I have loved this app for fertility and then pregnancy tracking. Unfortunately in the last few days they added a pay wall for basic week to week pregnancy updates. Terribly greedy. I hope many users delete and go to a free app.

reviews.title: Greet app
reviews.text: If you wanna know when exactly you will have your period get this app the best

reviews.title: Now charging
reviews.text: They now charge for features that used to be free like the weekly update!!

reviews.title: Sudden paywall
reviews.text: Mid cycle suddenly lost access to part cycle data

reviews.title: Nice until…
reviews.text:
This app used to be very helpful, but recently they have started gatekeeping more an more of my own previously logged data behind an every encroaching wall of subscription prices. 

They are taking away more and more features from the free version. I had a whole year of cycles logged on here and now I can only see the current cycles chart. I spent $30 on their brand thermometer to pair with the app, but I guess that’s not enough. 

Taking away features and personal health data I had access to before will not motivate me to get a paid subscription. Nope. 

Ladies, please explore other apps that have better free options, or log your BBT using a free template online before spending your money on this. I should have done that from the beginning.

reviews.title: Too many new changes, not for the better
reviews.text:
Edit to add…

I don’t like the new update where the free version loses things you were already using. Now I can’t see my past cycle and you can no longer ask a question from the chat box.  Prior to this it was my favorite and I recommended it. But now seems too expensive for the basics. 

I’ve been using this for a few weeks. So far I have found it to be helpful. The AI chat box answered one of my complicated questions. 
What I HATE about this app is the layout. It’s super confusing. Sometimes I think something is wrong or abnormal, or it will be like see some sort of report and you click on it, and it’s an example of someone else’s report. Kind of confusing. I feel like put the things you need to pay for in a completely separate category. Having them mixed in is breaking my brain. 🤣

reviews.title: Very Inaccurate
reviews.text: Inaccurate results. Also, while it’s a “free app” after you BUY the test strips, basically nothing within the app is actually free. So you have to buy the test strips AND buy the app. Even when you do that, the results don’t track. It has not been helpful at all for me at predicting ovulation. I’ve switched to another method that has now given me different results than this app!

reviews.title: Recent update ruined it
reviews.text:
If you want guaranteed access to your cycle data, get a different app. 
I have been using this app to track my fertility journey for over a year, and over time they’ve increased the amount of things you have to pay for  in order to access. This most recent update made it to where you have to pay to access your previous cycles without any warning. My cycle data where I’ve been tracking multiple factors while doing fertility treatments is now gone, unless I agree to pay $6/month. Another sad story of a truly good product and resource ruined by the greed of companies who found one more thing they could charge people for.

reviews.title: App
reviews.text: Great app and helps me with my periods and keeping track of my body

reviews.title: Ads and Manipulation
reviews.text: The app is mainly for people who are TTC, or at least that’s how I’ve seen it advertised. It was very annoying to be locked into their products in order to record my ovulation test kits and other results, but today I got a very disturbing message asking me to log today. “No pressure to log everything, Just today would mean a lot. A word, a number, anything.” What a creepy and gross message — “just today” would mean a lot to who? I’m days away from testing and never use the community feature. Immediate delete.

reviews.title: Paywall
reviews.text:
So I'm 38 weeks pregnant today and was looking forward to my weekly update as I've used this app since conception and even before. Nope need to pay all the sudden. Ridiculous cause there are 100 free other weekly updates that are free (baby list, what to expect, Boston medical to name a few). You're going to lose a lot of loyal users over this. Will be deleting unfortunately. 


Also why am I going to pay 20$ for three months when all I want are another few weeks of updates till I deliver? Absolutely idiotic. Bad move.

reviews.title: Took away weekly pregnancy updates
reviews.text: This app was already full of additional subscription items, but its ridiculous that they took away something as basic as “what size fruit is your baby”

reviews.title: losing me
reviews.text: i’ve used it for over a year, but the struggle to let me track my cycle after a miscarriage is disgusting. i can’t even log my ovulation in my cycle after miscarriage bc it says i need to log “previous period” and i had a miscarriage! and i can’t even change it so it can help me! thinking of just switching to a new app.

reviews.title: One day use
reviews.text: I’ll be so real, ordered strips on amazon last night, arrived this morning, 0.81 to 0.65 t/c ratio for two tests today only. this app is an absolute blessings for couples in the TTC stage!!

reviews.title: Thanks for the paywall. App is useless.
reviews.text: I have been using this app for a long time. Though I didn’t have all the features, I enjoyed reading about my baby each week. I am so disappointed and disgusted. The app is essentially useless to me now. Deleting.

reviews.title: Suddenly have to pay for all features? Try free Ovia app instead!
reviews.text: I do NOT recommend this app. I’ve used this app for all four of my pregnancies. Everything this app used to offer for free you could simply google or track on ChatGPT. But I used this app because I liked the free features and it had all my data in one place. Out of nowhere, all of my collected data over the years is now hidden until I pay for it. I can’t even see the simple weekly updates on my baby. This was all without any kind of warning, email, something! Pre mom please make this right!

reviews.title: Stop charging!
reviews.text: I liked this app. I enjoyed having a place to track my ovulation and periods. I also enjoyed weekly updates on my pregnancy. Until they changed it! Now I have to pay for most of this?! How stupid. No, I will not pay for it. I’ll find a different app to use, thank you very much. Wish I could give 0 stars.

reviews.title: Personal Data Hidden behind Paywall without Warning
reviews.text: I would never have tracked my period with this app if I knew they would be hiding MY history that I tracked behind a paywall!!!

reviews.title: Falta de menstruacion y avisar a la capital Haigh sin ser cierto
reviews.text: No hay reseña

reviews.title: App unusable without payment
reviews.text: I used the app to track my pregnancy, the only feature not locked behind the paywall was the general information about baby’s weekly progress. Today, that feature is now locked behind the paywall making the whole app unusable without a paying a ridiculous amount for something that was already free. I regret putting my information in this app which now I cannot access. Deleted this app immediately after.

reviews.title: Really Bummed - Paywall
reviews.text: App WAS great. I used it for ovulation tracking and got pregnant quickly. It switched over to the pregnancy view once we were successful. My husband and I really loved the weekly and trimester updates that I now can no longer see without premium. I’ll be finding another app for pregnancy updates and fertility tracking for my next pregnancy.

reviews.title: Money hungry
reviews.text: Great for tracking basic stuff when I was TTC, but now that I’m pregnant, trying to make me PAY so I can see the size of my baby per week is insane. I’d rather be exposed to little banners of ads than pay $6 a month.

reviews.title: Unimpressed.
reviews.text: Past data is now all behind a paywall. I’ve had the paid version prior to the September update and it’s not worth the money.

reviews.title: Bait-&-switch membership fees
reviews.text: Was using pre-mom to track my pre-pregnancy and pregnancy data. With no warning at all, I went to look at my account today to discover that they have locked me out of all useful areas unless I now pay for a “premium account.” Total bait-&-switch and completely disappointing for hopeful mothers relying on their data continuing to be accessible. Avoid at all costs

reviews.title: Weekly updates
reviews.text: I’m not sure when it changed or why but I was receiving weekly pregnancy tips and updates and I logged in today to get my weekly update and now it wants me to pay for a subscription. This was disappointing because I used them for my first pregnancy and now I have to find a new app.

reviews.title: Sudden Paywall
reviews.text: Used to be a great app but the sudden paywall change with no warning was talking jarring. The free features are now so limited it’s not really worth getting. If you have the money to pay for it I guess it would still be good.

reviews.title: App locked itself on purchase page
reviews.text: Unable to use the app when I need it most because it stuck on the pay for this app page. I’ve been using this app for a few years and it just gets progressively worse and worse each time. The pop ups are ridiculous and not it’s forcing me to pay to use locking out the free stuff. Very predatory.

reviews.title: Paywall
reviews.text: Disappointing. Deleting my account.

reviews.title: Recent update paywall
reviews.text:
I started using this app in February when we were TTC and then I got pregnant in April. I paid for the premium features while TTC so I could access all the helpful data. When I got pregnant in April, I mostly just used the app to see my week by week progress so I went back to the free version. 

All of a sudden, after an update, without warning, I couldn’t see anything without a paid subscription. No warning or anything. Now all my data is blocked without paying for it, without notice! Not sure how this is ethical but also so disappointing. Especially because I had paid in the past and used their ovulation strips and pregnancy tests. Now the entire app is basically useless unless you pay. Would 100% recommend prior to this update but useless now.

reviews.title: No good anymore
reviews.text: Anything that used to be useful about this app is gone. Shady that they’ll happily use our data but won’t even let us view it anymore.

reviews.title: Tracking works so well!
reviews.text: We had been trying for 3-4 months before I bought the ovulation strips, and it only took two months of tracking ovulation to get pregnant! My cycles are insanely irregular (varying from 26 days to 37 days) so I just never had any idea when I was actually ovulating. The app works perfect to track and give tips and let you know hey it’s time to try! I do not think I could have gotten pregnant so quickly without the ovulation testing, highly recommend!

reviews.title: Not user friendly
reviews.text: This app is difficult to understand and is not efficient at all.   I got notifications on my phone and have no clue where to go in the app to read these notifications.  Unacceptable! As that is a common feature that people rely on.  It also keeps reminding me to check LH although I have already had a peak?  For $26 of should know not to keep reminding me?  I also input that I had IUI which should also stop the LH reminders? For $26 it should.

reviews.title: OUTSTANDING APP
reviews.text: From the start this app has been nothing but accurate and informative. I should have found it sooner.

reviews.title: Paywall Nonsense
reviews.text: Am currently 17 weeks 5 days pregnant and went to check the app when all of a sudden I have to pay to see all of my past data and information? Absolutely not. This is ridiculous Premom, and you should be ashamed. I will be deleting the app and moving to a different company who is not predatory. Really loved this app, but not anymore.

reviews.title: Price Gouging
reviews.text: I was using this app to track my periods and ovulation in order to finally get pregnant, which I did, but I’ve noticed with the recent updates that certain features have become unavailable without a membership. I few weeks ago I was able to use the weight feature and see the pregnancy guide week by week and day by day. Now, I can no longer go directly into the weight feature and the full guide is unavailable. I’m able to see my current day’s guide, but I can no longer go back to previous days and when I go to read the full article I have to pay. I’m a low income mom and cannot afford to pay membership fees for basic features that were available to me before. I wouldn’t be so shocked if this was a thing when I first got the app, but it appears that the more updates that get sent out, the more money they require from you.

reviews.title: App behind paywall randomly
reviews.text: Woke up as I’ve been doing once a week to check on my baby, and today the whole app has been put behind a paywall overnight. At 37 weeks, I have to now pay a monthly subscription for the things i’ve been seeing every day for free. The app already had features behind paywall and now has just made everything that way. I would say it’s not worth the price.  there are other apps that do the same thing for free. I’ll be uninstalling and not using this in the future due to this.

reviews.title: Put my data behind a paywall
reviews.text: Dont use this app. They took my data and are making me pay to see it.

reviews.title: Pay to use
reviews.text: This app used to be super helpful and I could see how big my baby was throughout the pregnancy but they must be hurting for money now because most of the features I used to use before are now locked under a subscription. Wish they had kept it the way it was, won’t use them again for my next ovulation or pregnancy going forward

reviews.title: Paywall
reviews.text: Used to love reading this app every week for updates and information about what to expect with pregnancy and now they’re is a PAYWALL unless I unlock with a subscription. What the heck! It happened out of no where. Very sad and frustrating. Deleting the app

reviews.title: Paywall for past data
reviews.text: They just rolled out a paywall to see your past data. That is not ok. I understand it is a free app but I buy their brand strips so it should be free for anyone who does. Inito is free for their strip users. I have almost a year of data I can no longer look at to compare my current cycle to my past ones. I submitted a privacy act data request because I’m in California so we’ll see if they respond to that. I’ll be deleting the app once I get my data and using another brand. This was going too far Premom. I’ll also be ordering other strips to use as well with my other apps. It is a shame they did this. I think they’ll lose a lot of users this way.

reviews.title: Premom user
reviews.text: Offers great free information without trying to take your money

reviews.title: Love this app for LH tracking!
reviews.text: This app is awesome! The first time I used it for LH tracking I got pregnant. It's so easy and straightforward for the little ovulation test strips.

reviews.title: Subscription plan is unfortunate
reviews.text: So I've been using this app to log LH test strips for a few months because I attempted to switch to FAM. Well I found out I'm pregnant last week and today I saw an email letting me know that there was a paywall change, being implemented immediately. According to the email "past records remain in your account" whatever that means. And I can't see my past cycles from before the paywall change (which feels like ransoming the data) instead of 'data logged before the change remains accessable for free, data logged the day of the change and after are subject to the new subscription plan'. Needless to say I'm deleting the app and not recommending it to anyone.

reviews.title: Have to pay for most features
reviews.text: Not really a free app. I’ve had it for a few months now and they continue taking away features and forcing you to pay for it. Will not be using this app anymore.

reviews.title: Paywall nonsense
reviews.text: Without warning the app put all of my previous months of data behind a paywall. Data that I’ve been using and referencing as I try to get my hormones balanced, cycle on track and TTC. This is incredibly frustrating and I now regret becoming a premom app user.

reviews.title: Money hungry
reviews.text: I feel like the more I use this app, the more features are being moved behind a paywall. About a month ago, I was able to view my entire chart history for free, but now I’m being asked to pay $0.99 to access it. What concerns me is that these features were originally presented as part of the free version when I created my account not as a free trial. Later, the app can change the terms and say that the “premium app is changing,” but from a user’s perspective, the experience feels essentially the same, just with more features now carrying additional costs. If you’re considering this app, be aware that features advertised as free may later become paid.

reviews.title: Data being held hostage
reviews.text: This is my third cycle using premom to log my BBT and to my surprise when I opened the app to log my bbt and view my chart the past two cycles are behind a paywall! My data is being held hostage !! I’m highly disappointed in premom to monetize on the TTC community. I just want to see my BBT for the past two months it’s down the drain unless I pay.

reviews.title: Overstimulating and filled with upsell pop-ups
reviews.text:
I only use the free version of this app to log my OPK strips, but wow is this app AWFUL. Every time I open it up it takes a very long time to work (it’s frozen and none of the options do anything if you click them). When it finally works, you get pop-ups entering to sell you their OPKs and pregnancy tests (which I already buy) or to pay for the premium version. It’s overstimulating garbage and I wish there was another app I could use to track my LH strips.

They also recently posted an update that forces you to pay to see previous cycle data, which seems very unethical to hide someone’s medical data behind a paywall.

reviews.title: Premom
reviews.text: This app is awesome! It helped me keep track of my periods and eventually aiding in helping to get pregnant naturally. The test strips they recommend were a huge help in letting me know when I was ovulating or not. Thanks Premom for making my experience so smooth :) can’t wait to be a mom!

reviews.title: Surprise Paywall
reviews.text: After logging daily with this app for 6 months, I go to check my past cycle yesterday and it’s blocked unless I subscribe to premium. I’ve been accessing it for 6 months and now with no warning all MY data is paywalled. Just another predatory company making you rely on them and then snatching it away to force you to fill their deep pockets. Shame on you, PreMom.

reviews.title: Locked Out
reviews.text: Used to love the free version of the app. Their most recent update has locked out all usable features unless you pay for the subscription. Very pointless now and I have removed the app. I’ll keep using Apple health for all my tracking needs now thanks to the changes.

reviews.title: Sudden Paywall for all Data and Features

This is a significant miss for Premom. As a (hopeful) future mom who’s been trying for almost 3 years. I really relied on this data. I don’t have the means to spend $6+/month on top of my fertility treatments. Such a disappointment. I can do more in excel by myself. Will unfortunately have to delete the app because it does not serve me anymore.

reviews.title: Tubal reversal and Premom
reviews.text:
Update: I’m 42 years old and using this App and strips, we now have a 1 year old little girl and our son is 4! Best advice I can give, find your LH PEAK and stay on top of it. 4 days before you ovulate try to make the time! It takes semen 4 days to travel. You want them in there before your egg drops 💚 Plan for success, if you nail your levels down and don’t have any reason with you biologically or physically, you should get pregnant very quickly. At least it has helped me and our family! Hopes this helps you all!

Original review: At my age 38, our chances were very low, but I got this app and it took us roughly 8 months total. 4 of which we had this app… our son is now 6 months old 💚 I do not feel that would have been possible without the assistance of Premom.

reviews.title: Terrible New App Feature
reviews.text: I have never written an app review before but feel compelled to write one because of the new feature on the Premom app (which I have been using for a few years). Recently, they have started displaying—in a banner at the top of the app—how many users recorded a BFP from the previous day (a number in the thousands). As someone who has been dealing with unexplained infertility for multiple years, it is a *terrible* user experience to have to login and see that now every time I use the app—and be reminded of my inability to become pregnant. I find this new feature extremely insensitive and not at all trauma-informed for women dealing with infertility, loss, and other challenges around conception. I am seeking out another option for tracking my fertility, as I don’t need to be using something that causes pain every time I open it.

reviews.title: Contradicting Results & Misleading Ovulation Tracking
reviews.text:
I’m extremely disappointed with the Premom app. It originally predicted my ovulation date as September 3, so I relied on the app while testing daily. My LH tests on 8/28 and 8/29 reached 0.75, but the app labeled them “Low” and continued saying I had not reached my peak.

Then on Sep 1, the app suddenly changed and said I had ovulated three days earlier, while the test screen STILL said “no surge yet.” How can I have already ovulated when the app never detected a peak and was predicting September 3?

Now the app in one section states “Normal Luteal” and in another section “Abnormal Luteal”. Which one is it?!? Very confusing data. 
 
For women actively trying to conceive, this is a serious issue. I relied on this information to time intercourse and have completely missed my fertile window. The app needs to clearly distinguish between an estimated ovulation date and ovulation actually supported by LH results. This experience has made me lose confidence in the app.

reviews.title: Charging Users To Access Their Own Data
reviews.text: I’ve used Premom for years and have always had access to my past cycle charts. Suddenly, that access has been put behind a Premium subscription. Honestly, this feels like a blatant money grab. This isn’t new Premium content—it’s years of personal fertility data that I entered into the app myself, which I’m now being asked to pay to access. Taking an existing feature away from long-time users and then charging us to get it back feels incredibly unfair and has really changed my opinion of the app.

reviews.title:
Ignores support tickets & breaks core
Apple Health BBT import
reviews.text:
Do not rely on Premom for cycle tracking. Out of nowhere, the app completely stopped importing BBT data from Apple Health, despite still syncing every other metric without issue.
I did all the legwork: exhaustively troubleshooted settings, gathered
screenshots, and sent detailed emails to their support team. After putting on a front like they wanted to assist, support dropped the ball entirely. Zero follow-up, no ticket updates, and no resolution. When you are tracking ovulation, daily temperature timing is everything. An app that fails at basic health data integration and offers zero real customer support isn't worth keeping on your phone.
